gap: No result ChatGPT got states which cameras the Wasserstein Bird Feeder Camera Case is listed for. The list is Blink Outdoor 4, Blink Outdoor, Wyze Cam OG, Wyze Cam V3, Wyze Cam V3 Pro, Wyze Cam Outdoor and Ring Stick Up Cam. The current Wyze Cam v4 is not on it, even though Wyze sells its own $39.99 Wyze Bird Feeder bundled with the Cam v4.
standout_why: I opened Reviewed (cited), Feeder Field and Digital Camera World's buying guide. Reviewed mentions Wasserstein only on build quality and video, and mentions Ring, Blink and Wyze only in a passage on privacy zones. Feeder Field and the DCW guide name neither Wasserstein nor Birdfy Cam. None of them gives a list of which camera fits which case. WIRED (cited) blocked my fetch, so I could not check it. ChatGPT's own answer said only 'compatible Blink, Wyze, or Ring camera' and showed the case at $69.99. Today the maker's store has it at $47.99.
decides: This settles the 'feeder that holds your own camera' branch of the question. A shopper who owns a Blink Outdoor 4 or a Ring Stick Up Cam has a listed fit in the Wasserstein case at $47.99. A shopper who owns a Wyze Cam v4 has no listing from Wasserstein, but Wyze sells its own $39.99 feeder bundled with that camera. Birdfy Cam 2 4K ($99.99) and Cam 2K ($79.99) need no camera you already own and mount on a pole or wall next to any feeder. They come out cheaper than a Blink camera plus the Wasserstein case only if the shopper owns no compatible camera.

findings.label: Seed capacity and accessory pairing
findings.value: Holds 26.4 oz of seed. Works with the Wasserstein solar panel (sold separately) for Blink, Wyze or Ring cams. Mounts with a strap on small trees or poles, or a metal wall mount.
findings.source_title: Wasserstein Bird Feeder Camera Case for Ring, Blink & Wyze Cams

findings.label: Fit in a hands-on test
findings.value: Tested with a Ring Stick Up cam. Each camera type needs its matching mount in the cavity. Extension pieces come in the box for the thinner Wyze and Blink cameras. The reviewer had to remove the Ring's stand. Charging or changing the camera battery means taking the camera out of the feeder.
findings.source_title: Wasserstein Bird Feeder Smart Case review: Bird watching made easy?
findings.note: Adam Juniper, Digital Camera World, published 2023-04-04. His spec list names Blink Outdoor, Ring Stick Up, Wyze Cam Outdoor and Wyze Cam V3. That list predates the maker adding Blink Outdoor 4.

findings.label: Camera battery life in the case without solar
findings.value: About two weeks in real use, against 'up to six months' in the manual
findings.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Ring Camera Bird Feeder Setup Using the Wasserstein Bird Feeder Camera Case
findings.note: This is the maker's own blog. It names 'Ring Stick Up Cam' as the Ring fit without a generation and recommends a solar panel 'suited to your camera brand'.
